allow: Bash(echo "=== bash_history: Treffer zu ssh/rsync/scp/IP ===" && grep -n "192.168.10.13\\|ssh \\|rsync\\|scp \\|deploy" ~/.bash_history 2>/dev/null | tail -40 || echo "\(keine bash_history / keine Treffer\)")

PowerShell($h = \(Get-PSReadlineOption\).HistorySavePath; Write-Output "History-Datei: $h"; if \(Test-Path $h\) { Select-String -Path $h -Pattern "192.168.10.13|ssh|rsync|scp|plesk|deploy|git push" | Select-Object -Last 40 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line } } else { Write-Output "\(keine PSReadline-History gefunden\)" })
